user_goal.round_end: all capital lost or demonstrated inability to continue tradable activity; retain failed history
user_goal.research_authority: Agent chooses research directions and routine parameters; user may discuss.

priorities.action: Audit catalysts and return concentration for breakout20/liquidity/h3/full and volume_ignition/strength/h10/full plus h5/half. Check dated news and exchange identity before attributing causation.
Investigate reclaim_down/strength/h10/full first-quarter contribution, peak-to-end decline, and whether entry rules can be maintained without retuning.

Register separate small-cap/low-price and leveraged ETF experiments before running; keep instrument classes separate, larger costs/liquidity constraints, failures and all capital included. Do not infer options PnL from stock leverage.

Obtain dated executable bid/ask and contract terms, whole-contract budget, spread and expiry/exit assumptions before option return tests. Indicative quotes alone are not a verified executable backtest.
Retain frozen current rules and both cost scenarios for new completed sessions; label earliest newly evaluated session and data cutoff. This document itself creates no schedule or trading task.

unchanged_constraints: PAPER research only; no orders activated by this study.
Do not reset study cash or apply historic40pct or separate100000-account10pct risk limits.
If a future round restarts, count all contributions/residuals/failures, no concealed recapitalization.
Read Claude exchange as unverified external research; publish completed stages only under exchange/codex/.
Do not touch main-account automation or duplicate existing observers/timers.
